card.name: Inside reversible and irreversible adverbs
card.fires_on: The middle or end of the words irreversibly and reversibly (the pieces 'vers' and 'ibly'), mostly describing how a drug binds or acts. Weaker on a few other adjectives such as irreversible, perennial, single-use and open-label.

modes.label: Reversibly / irreversibly
modes.description: Partway through the adverb describing whether a drug's binding or effect can be undone.
modes.example: in animal studies, TEMBEXA may irre<<vers>>ibly impair fertility in individuals of reproductive potential

modes.description: Weaker firing on adjectives such as irreversible, perennial or hyphenated single-use and open-label.
